title: Teaching Material Summary
description: Per EO-S1.1-001 v1.1. Every array entry must be traceable to the real source material — nothing composed or invented. Empty arrays are honest (a section the material doesn't support), never padded.

reviewSuggestions.description: 複習建議 — 選填。Sprint AI-112 AI-702: formalizes a field this Repository's own downstream consumers (js/components/SummaryCenter.js) already needed and, until now, could only derive at render time when a Package genuinely had none. When the source material supports real review guidance, it belongs here, traceable to the material like every other array in this schema; omitted (not an empty-array placeholder) when the material doesn't support it.
